description: The view from the flat (27th floor, Tel Aviv): city-pano.jpg = 180° of city (west -> north -> east), rows linear in tan(elevation) with the horizon at row 261 of 1024 (tan +0.2 at the top, 1304 px per unit tan), built from crops of the survey photos 20261027_160717/160719/160720 (balcony); city-pano-alpha.jpg = its skyline mask; facade-stone.jpg / facade-glass.jpg = self-made procedural facades (CC0) for the two nearby towers seen in 160703/160717 and 160659/160723.
